Jo: quick capture from today's onboarding calls — three customers hit the same thing: can't find per-route billing toggle, asking for a simple cost example, and one asked about team keys.
Jo: verbatim: "Where is the billing toggle? we almost cancelled setup" (MapleHealth), "show costs per 100k tokens please" (Nimbus), "we need team API keys for staging" (OrbitLabs).
Asha: counts and risk?
Jo: MapleHealth (paid, renewal in 4w, flagged), Nimbus (pilot, 2 teams), OrbitLabs (trial, security).
Ben: small fixes first: surface the toggle with a badge + tooltip linking to cost-preview. estimate 1 dev day + 1 ux day.
Asha: I'll do a one-minute screencast CSMs can use and template email for MapleHealth. 48h.
Ben: team keys is bigger (auth/RBAC) — backlog under security.
Ezra-bot: CS-7781 created: "Surface per-route billing toggle + cost-preview + CSM enablement" assigned Asha, priority P2, due 3d.
Jo: adding renewal note for MapleHealth and assigning follow-up. I'll paste raw quotes to the ticket.
Asha: tagging signals: onboarding-ux, billing-visibility, api-keys-request.
Ben: agree this is quick win. scheduling canary after mock.
